C08-M06-L05-F1.title: Feed-management pipeline: from four sources to action
C08-M06-L05-F1.caption: Every indicator is normalised, deduplicated, allowlist-checked, scored and aged before it may drive detection or blocking.
C08-M06-L05-F1.alt: Graph. Four slate source boxes - Open feeds (free, thin context), Commercial feeds (curated, licensed), ISAC / community (relevant, under TLP) and Internal cases (proven against us) - each point into Normalise (canonical type + value). The chain continues to Deduplicate and merge (one record, all sources), then the green Allowlist filter (own and shared infrastructure), then the orange Score (confidence x reliability x age), then the violet Age out (past valid_until: history only). From Age out an arrow labelled high score, current leads to the dark Detect / block box, and an arrow labelled low score or expired leads to the blue Enrich / hunt box. A dashed arrow labelled false matches, sightings returns from Enrich / hunt to ISAC / community.
C08-M06-L05-F1.note: Never connect a feed straight to a blocklist.
